source_authority: Latest owner decisions in this conversation; operational defaults require approval before activation.
supersedes: new-case level-5 weighted voting and mandatory trained panel approval

actions.label: Create three qualifying human-authored posts
actions.rule: One 250-point award after three distinct accepted human-authored posts; not a per-post reward.

actions.label: Constructive top-level comment on your post
actions.rule: One validated own-post comment or meaningful follow-up; shares a single 150-point award with own-post replies. Rubric approval required.

actions.label: Constructive reply within your post
actions.rule: A valid contextual reply; shares a single 150-point weekly award with own-post comments. No obligation to reply to abuse.

actions.label: Constructive top-level comment on another member’s post
actions.rule: One validated contextual contribution; shares a single 150-point weekly award with replies on others’ posts.

actions.label: Constructive reply on another member’s post
actions.rule: One validated contextual reply; shares a single 150-point weekly award with comments on others’ posts. No obligation to agree.

actions.label: Validated usefulness feedback
actions.rule: Candidate shadow rubric: at least five independent valid helpfulness judgements; helpful share >=80% earns 250, >=60% earns 125, otherwise zero. Insufficient evidence is not misconduct.

actions.label: Constructive discussion outcomes
actions.rule: Candidate shadow rubric: 125 per independently accepted constructive conversation outcome, maximum two distinct contexts and counterparties.

actions.label: Independently validated contribution value
actions.rule: Candidate shadow rubric: 125 per independently accepted useful outcome, maximum two. Derived bonus must explicitly reference evidence; not another primary contribution award.

actions.label: Accurate declarations and policy compliance
actions.rule: Requires actual qualifying public participation and honest declarations. AI-assisted participation may qualify for compliance, never authorship.

actions.label: Qualifying human-authored contribution bonus
actions.rule: Requires accepted human-authored participation. An honestly labelled, permitted AI-assisted item does not erase unrelated human-authorship evidence.

actions.label: Participate in a timed peer appeal
actions.rule: Candidate operational rule: one valid, context-aware final ballot earns the weekly award. No award for vote direction, winning side or repeated ballots.

actions.label: Accepted source contribution
actions.rule: 150 per distinct accepted sourcing task, maximum two across source and correction actions combined.

actions.label: Accepted correction
actions.rule: 150 per distinct accepted correction task, maximum two across source and correction actions combined. No manufactured-error farming.

actions.label: Accepted community help
actions.rule: 125 per distinct accepted task, maximum two across help and accessibility actions combined.

actions.label: Accepted accessibility contribution
actions.rule: 125 per distinct accepted task, maximum two across help and accessibility actions combined.

actions.label: Breadth of qualifying participation
actions.rule: Candidate default: complete four of the six substantive families; one 150-point bonus. Family alternatives are not additional categories.

actions.label: Account-integrity assessment completed
actions.rule: Lythaus assessment of available provider and authenticated behavioural evidence. Missing telemetry or an outage is unknown, not automatic clearance or guilt.

actions.label: Strong authentication / 2FA maintained
actions.rule: Proposed default: continuous server-recorded protection throughout the calendar month, plus successful qualifying authentication evidence. A suitable multi-factor passkey can satisfy this condition.

actions.label: User-protected credential maintained
actions.rule: Proposed default: continuously registered, unrevoked credential for the calendar month and a valid server-verified user-verification assertion. Fingerprint, face, PIN and pattern are not separate awards.

actions.label: Successful anti-automation check
actions.rule: One server-validated eligible check in the source month. Existing validated challenge evidence can satisfy the award; do not reuse the consumed token.

actions.label: Community and authorship refresher
actions.rule: One accessible current-policy comprehension activity. No speed, language-polish or daily-streak criterion.

actions.label: Reverify registered email control
actions.rule: One unrevoked proof valid for three calendar months. Eligible month-end snapshots include 1,000 while it is valid. Renewal replaces validity; it never stacks points.

calendar.week_owner_month: calendar month of the closing Sunday
calendar.cross_month_week: assigned once; displayed with its exact date range
calendar.missing_weeks: zero; no artificial catch-up or prorating
calendar.quarterly_validity: three calendar months from verification timestamp; clamp target day at month end
calendar.quarterly_snapshot_rule: proof valid immediately before month-end cutoff; never count a verification performed at or after cutoff

binding.standard_case_decision: equal-weight community decision under the approved threshold
binding.eligibility: registered email-verified member; no active voting restriction; no self-vote or relevant conflict

proposed_defaults.winning_share_rule: strict majority of valid allow vs retain ballots; ties unresolved
proposed_defaults.insufficient_quorum_or_tie_after_extensi: unresolved; accountable case review with explicit reason, not automatic guilt
proposed_defaults.restricted_safety_cases: separate restricted-review route, not a hidden override for ordinary disagreement

security.minimum_friction: reuse validated normal authentication and challenge evidence where the award conditions are met

free.selection: one reward family total; not a monthly reset

premium.selection: one selected reward per earned level; not five level-five offers

black.selection: all eligible reward families subject to offer terms

partner_api.recurring_fulfilment: authorised merchant subscription and invoice-period idempotency; no new member consent every invoice

reports.public: policy, points catalogue, calculation method and aggregate transparency
reports.private: own per-action evidence references, all weekly results, selected/excluded weeks, corrections, source-month totals, next-month entitlement and partner links

freeze.starts_at: approved activation of the policy, not document creation
freeze.emergency_changes: versioned security exception with audit and owner approval; no secret reward-weight edits

activation_gates: working security and quality evidence paths
safe equal-vote appeal process and staffing for unresolved/sensitive cases
explicit live provider and release approvals

WebAuthn Level 2, user verification and biometric privacy

notes: Tests check the proposed arithmetic, calendar defaults and reference fixtures; not application, provider, security or database implementation.
